St. Johns Investment Management Company LLC lessened its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 8.5% in the third quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 20,502 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,896 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for approximately 3.5% of St. Johns Investment Management Company LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 5th largest position. St. Johns Investment Management Company LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,628,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other hedge funds have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. Pennsylvania Trust Co grew its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.4% in the 2nd quarter. Pennsylvania Trust Co now owns 294,543 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $54,523,000 after acquiring an additional 4,136 shares during the period. Guidant Wealth Advisors grew its holdings in shares of Apple by 99.2% in the 2nd quarter. Guidant Wealth Advisors now owns 9,724 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $507,000 after acquiring an additional 4,842 shares during the period. James Hambro & Partners acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the 2nd quarter worth approximately $993,000. Daiwa SB Investments Ltd. grew its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.4% in the 2nd quarter. Daiwa SB Investments Ltd. now owns 27,620 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,113,000 after acquiring an additional 900 shares during the period. Finally, Augustine Asset Management Inc. grew its holdings in shares of Apple by 1.5% in the 2nd quarter. Augustine Asset Management Inc. now owns 63,812 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $11,812,000 after acquiring an additional 963 shares during the period. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 57.02% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
Shares of Apple stock opened at $157.76 on Monday. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $142.00 and a fifty-two week high of $233.47. The firm has a market cap of $775.41 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 13.29, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.78 by $0.13. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company posted $2.07 EPS. Analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.88 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
A number of brokerages have commented on AAPL. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reiterated a “buy” rating and set a $272.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 10th. Rosenblatt Securities set a $200.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, October 22nd. Bank of America reiterated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, October 9th. UBS Group set a $250.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, October 8th. Finally, Citigroup increased their target price on Apple from $230.00 to $265.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, October 8th. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple presently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $195.33.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
